# Server Configuration server.port=9090 spring.application.name=api-gateway
# Eureka Client Configuration eureka.client.service-url.defaultZone=http://localhost:8761/eureka/ eureka.client.fetch-registry=true eureka.client.register-with-eureka=true eureka.instance.prefer-ip-address=true
# Gateway Discovery Locator spring.cloud.gateway.discovery.locator.enabled=true spring.cloud.gateway.discovery.locator.lower-case-service-id=true
# Auth Service Route spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].id=auth-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].uri=lb://AUTH-SERVICE spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].predicates[0]=Path=/api/auth/** spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].filters[0]=RewritePath=/api/auth/(?<segment>.*), /${segment}
# Patient Service Route spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].id=patient-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].uri=lb://PATIENT-SERVICE spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].predicates[0]=Path=/api/patients/** spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].filters[0]=RewritePath=/api/patients/(?<segment>.*), /api/patients/${segment} spring.cloud.gateway.routes[1].filters[1]=AuthenticationFilter
# Appointment Service Route spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].id=appointment-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].uri=lb://APPOINTMENT-SERVICE spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].predicates[0]=Path=/api/appointments/** spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].filters[0]=RewritePath=/api/appointments/(?<segment>.*), /api/appointments/${segment} spring.cloud.gateway.routes[2].filters[1]=AuthenticationFilter
# EHR Service Route spring.cloud.gateway.routes[3].id=ehr-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[3].uri=lb://EHR-SERVICE spring.cloud.gateway.routes[3].predicates[0]=Path=/api/ehr/** spring.cloud.gateway.routes[3].filters[0]=RewritePath=/api/ehr/(?<segment>.*), /api/ehr/${segment} spring.cloud.gateway.routes[3].filters[1]=AuthenticationFilter
# Pharmacy Service Route spring.cloud.gateway.routes[4].id=pharmacy-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[4].uri=lb://PHARMACY-SERVICE spring.cloud.gateway.routes[4].predicates[0]=Path=/api/pharmacy/** spring.cloud.gateway.routes[4].filters[0]=RewritePath=/api/pharmacy/(?<segment>.*), /api/pharmacy/${segment} spring.cloud.gateway.routes[4].filters[1]=AuthenticationFilter
# Billing Service Route spring.cloud.gateway.routes[5].id=billing-service spring.cloud.gateway.routes[5].uri=lb://BILLING-SERVICE spring.cloud.gateway.routes[5].predicates[0]=Path=/api/billing/** spring.cloud.gateway.routes[5].filters[0]=RewritePath=/api/billing/(?<segment>.*), /api/billing/${segment} spring.cloud.gateway.routes[5].filters[1]=AuthenticationFilter
# JWT Configuration jwt.secret=5367566B59703373367639792F423F4528482B4D6251655468576D5A71347437 jwt.expiration=86400000
# Actuator management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,gateway management.endpoint.gateway.enabled=true
# Logging logging.level.org.springframework.cloud.gateway=DEBUG logging.level.com.genc.api_gateway=DEBUG

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd"> <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion> <parent> <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId> <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId> <version>3.2.5</version> <relativePath/> </parent> <groupId>com.genc</groupId> <artifactId>api-gateway</artifactId> <version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version> <name>api-gateway</name> <description>API Gateway for PCCRMS</description>
<properties> <java.version>17</java.version> <spring-cloud.version>2023.0.1</spring-cloud.version> </properties>
<dependencies> <!-- Spring Cloud Gateway --> <dependency> <groupId>org.springframework.cloud</groupId> <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-gateway</artifactId> </dependency>
<!-- Eureka Client --> <dependency> <groupId>org.springframework.cloud</groupId> <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-netflix-eureka-client</artifactId> </dependency>
<!-- JWT --> <dependency> <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId> <artifactId>jjwt-api</artifactId> <version>0.12.5</version> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId> <artifactId>jjwt-impl</artifactId> <version>0.12.5</version> <scope>runtime</scope> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId> <artifactId>jjwt-jackson</artifactId> <version>0.12.5</version> <scope>runtime</scope> </dependency>
<!-- Actuator --> <dependency> <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId> <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId> </dependency>
<!-- Lombok --> <dependency> <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId> <artifactId>lombok</artifactId> <optional>true</optional> </dependency>
<dependency> <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId> <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId> <scope>test</scope> </dependency> </dependencies>
<dependencyManagement> <dependencies> <dependency> <groupId>org.springframework.cloud</groupId> <artifactId>spring-cloud-dependencies</artifactId> <version>${spring-cloud.version}</version> <type>pom</type> <scope>import</scope> </dependency> </dependencies> </dependencyManagement>
<build> <plugins> <plugin> <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId> <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId> <configuration> <excludes> <exclude> <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId> <artifactId>lombok</artifactId> </exclude> </excludes> </configuration> </plugin> </plugins> </build>
</project>
